output.title: ClusterIssuer kubectl short name improves operator convenience
output.content: This change adds the `ciss` short name for ClusterIssuer resources, a kubectl convenience feature similar to the `iss` short name added for Issuer resources. Operators managing this cert-manager deployment will benefit from shorter kubectl syntax when working with ClusterIssuer resources. This is a non-breaking convenience enhancement that plausibly applies to any operator using ClusterIssuer resources.
